Specifications

FOUNDATION

Specially designed R.C.C. Pile Foundation to resist Earthquake.

STRUCTURE

R.C.C. framed structure.

WALLS

Premium quality concrete hollow blocks are used to build walls.

Wall Finish

Finest quality cement mortar plastering and weather coat finish for external Walls .Internal walls will have excellent putty surface and emulsion paint finish.

DOORS& WINDOWS

Hardwood front door, moulded panel doors for interiors. Powder coated aluminium windows with M.S. grills and glass panes.

FLOORING

Impressive flooring concepts - with Vitrified tiles- for apartments, ground floor lobby, passages and main staircase.

KITCHEN

Ideally designed kitchen with granite top and stainless sink with drain board.

ELECTRICAL WORK

Three phase power supply with concealed wiring controlledby ELCB/MCB except single bedroom. Elegant modular switches (Crabtree or equivalent). Split A/C provision in master bedroom.

WATER SUPPLY

Round the clock water supply through sump and overhead tanks. Drinking Water from KWA line in Kitchen . Water drawn from well for other purposes.

TELEPHONE & CABLE TV

Telephone and TV line provision in drawing room & master bedroom, Internet Provision.

CAR PARK

Concealed copper wiring. Adequate light points, fan points, 5 amps and 15 amps points, etc. with independent metres for each flat. Modular type switches. Provision for 3 phase electrical supply. Provision for cable TV and telephone conduit point in living room.

CAR PARKING

Car Park at extra cost.

*All alterations at extra cost
